_comment: D18. refuse: a public stateful method that writes state (a mutable property, directly or through a private helper) and calls addRawOutput but never addOutput (directly or through a helper) gets no auto-injected continuation (any addOutput/addRawOutput replaces it), so its state write is silently dropped and the contract's satoshis go to the spender's change; every tier refuses it with the shared diagnostic, on the source path (typecheck) and on the --ir path (ir-release-trap.test.ts). addDataOutput does not suppress the continuation and is no trigger. accept: a method that writes nothing and emits raw outputs (terminal by design), and a write carried by an addOutput (direct or in a helper), compile in every tier to the same bytes. The rule is per method, not per path: a write on a branch whose sibling calls addOutput is not refused (documented residual).
error_template: method '<method>' writes contract state but emits no state continuation: it calls addRawOutput() without addOutput(), and a method that declares its own outputs gets no auto-injected continuation, so the state write would be lost and the contract's satoshis would leave with the spend. Add this.addOutput(satoshis, ...) to carry the new state, or stop writing state in a method meant to end the contract
